name: pytacheck
description: Community modules and presets for pytacheck (and, in future, metacheck).

packs.name: clinical_trials
packs.title: Clinical trial checks
packs.description: Checks for clinical trial reports: finds trial registration numbers from the major registries and flags trials that report none.

modules.name: trial_registration
modules.title: Trial Registration
modules.description: Find clinical trial registration numbers (ClinicalTrials.gov, ISRCTN, EudraCT/CTIS, ANZCTR, ChiCTR, DRKS, CTRI, PACTR, UMIN/jRCT, IRCT, ReBEC, NTR) and flag trials that report none.

presets.default: metacheck's default report plus trial registration numbers

packs.name: fields
packs.title: Field presets
packs.description: Presets that pick metacheck's built-in checks for a field of research. No code: only module lists.

presets.general: Any empirical paper: metacheck's default report plus ethics approval and open-practice statements, which apply across fields
presets.psychology: Psychology: the general checks plus every reported p-value and causal claims about non-randomised designs, common reporting problems in the field
presets.medicine: Medicine: the general checks without the FLoRA replication lookup (it covers psychology studies); add the clinical_trials pack for trial registration numbers
presets.open-science: Transparency: preregistration, open-practice statements and what the shared repositories actually contain (files, code, data, codebooks, Psych-DS)
